rule.statement: Labour Tribunals are not bound by the notice requirement stipulated in section 54 of the SLPA Act.
rule.supporting_quote: Therefore, having analysed section 54 of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority Act, it can be held that Labour Tribunals are not bound by the notice requirement stipulated in section 54 of that Act and the question of law on which special leave was granted is answered in the affirmative.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Sri Lanka Ports Authority Act, section 54
